pr_title: roachprod: changes in promhelper client for modify labels
pr_body:
When a test is run, a new label has to be added to prometheus. To do this, we need to first get the current config, add the new label and update the config. This change does that. Post this change, the label update will be integrated.

The change also needs a change in httputil client GET function to support headers being passed.

Fixes: #124319
Epic: none
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/124460)

> Can you explain to me why we need to update the config this way? By the time we call `cluster.Start` the first time, we should already the test name and the run ID, is there a reason we can't add it all in one shot?

If a cluster is reused, do we always stop the nodes and then add the tags and start? If that is the case, we should be good without this change.

Yes, that's correct.

If we reuse a cluster, we call `c.WipeForReuse`.

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/99d7687ba82a614a509c62a12bed411de006d05b/pkg/cmd/roachtest/test_runner.go#L636-L637

This eventually calls `c.Stop`

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/6918532c343556a4dab10de0c9162f73fa712069/pkg/roachprod/install/cluster_synced.go#L547-L549

Same with removing labels. We call this at the end of `runTest`

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/99d7687ba82a614a509c62a12bed411de006d05b/pkg/cmd/roachtest/test_runner.go#L1031-L1033
Thats great! Then we should be good without this change. I will close this PR! Thanks for pointing out!!

issue_context.title: roachprod: prometheus file_sd_config has missing labels
issue_context.body:
Previously when the gce_sd_configs was used, few labels were read from the gce metadata using the config below:

 - source_labels: [__meta_gce_private_ip]
    separator: ;
    regex: (.*)
    target_label: instance
    replacement: ${1}:9100
    action: replace
  - source_labels: [__meta_gce_instance_name]
    separator: ;
    regex: (.*)
    target_label: job
    replacement: ${1}-sys
    action: replace
  - source_labels: [__meta_gce_instance_name]
    separator: ;
    regex: (.*)
    target_label: host
    replacement: ${1}
    action: replace
  - source_labels: [__meta_gce_label_cluster]
    separator: ;
    regex: (.*)
    target_label: cluster
    replacement: ${1}
    action: replace
  - source_labels: [__meta_gce_tags]
    separator: ;
    regex: (.*)
    target_label: instance_tags
    replacement: ${1}
    action: replace
  - source_labels: [__meta_gce_label_test_name]
    separator: ;
    regex: (.*)
    target_label: test_name
    replacement: ${1}
    action: replace
  - source_labels: [__meta_gce_label_test_run_id]
    separator: ;
    regex: (.*)
    target_label: test_run_id
    replacement: ${1}
    action: replace

Now, as we are using file_sd_configs, these configs has to be fed to prometheus in a different way.

The approach can be to add the labels directly to the file using the pormhelpers

Jira issue: CRDB-38823
comments: The issue is fixed with the previous commit as we set the test tags at start and we always restart the clusters before running a new test.

review_comments: `RemoveLabels` is for removing VM labels, should this be in it's own function?
